title: Top reasons US parents give for homeschooling (2023)

source.name: National Household Education Survey (NHES), homeschooling module

notes: Parents could select multiple reasons, so shares don't sum to 100%. Concern about the environment of other schools (safety, negative peer pressure, drugs) was the most commonly cited reason both before and after the pandemic, cited by 83% of homeschooling parents in the 2022-23 wave.
